### What is a 'Doc Maker'?+

Doc Makers have the power to create new docs and templates, create and manage folders to organize the workspace. Within docs, Doc Makers can administer tasks such as adding pages, changing doc and page titles and icons, adjusting the timezone, configuring doc and page locking, etc.

...

### Who do I pay for and why?+

When upgrading a free workspace to a paid plan, you get access to role-based permissions: each member can be either a Doc Maker (Admin), a Doc Maker, or an Editor. As you grow into Superhuman Docs, you can invite additional members to become Editors or Doc Makers in your workspace. Editors and Viewers are always free.

At the end of each billing cycle, you will be billed for the workspace based on the number of Doc Makers in it. Any changes to the number of Doc Makers in the workspace mid-cycle are automatically prorated.

...

When you sign up for a new plan, as well as when it renews, you will be billed up front for all the users in your workspace.

Whenever you add a new paid user to your workspace (or upgrade an existing one), we'll prorate them for the remainder of your billing cycle. On the annual plan, you will be charged monthly for these additional membership changes, with prorations applied for the remainder of the billing year. Additionally, you will be charged whenever your bill exceeds $1,000 from adding new members.

With Superhuman Docs, you only pay for Doc Makers. So when a Doc Maker is added or removed from your workspace (or downgraded to an editor), your bill is affected. Workspace admins can control how Doc Makers are added via their workspace settings. Check out this article to learn more.

results.title: Manage your Superhuman Docs billing account
results.content:
How do I know when my annual or monthly subscription will renew?

For customers on our Pro and Team/Business plans: The easiest way to know when you’ll be charged next is to look at your previous invoices. For instance - if you pay annually and your last invoice was on July 15th 2023, you can expect your next charge on July 15th 2024. If you pay monthly, you can expect your next charge on August 15th 2023.

...

Can I switch from monthly billing to annual billing (or vice versa)?

For customers on our Pro and Team/Business plans: If you’ve already paid for a subscription and would like to change the frequency of your future billing, you can do that by following these steps.

1. Go to your workspace home (docs.superhuman.com)
2. Click on your name in the lower-left corner
3. Select Admin settings from the menu
4. Scroll to find the Billing section, then click on the Workspace plan page
5. If you belong to multiple workspaces, use the workspace selector at the top of the page to ensure the correct workspace is selected
6. Then click Change plan
7. You’ll be brought to the Superhuman Docs pricing page. Use the toggle to change from Pay monthly to Pay annually (or vice versa).
8. Scroll down to the plan you already have (or the new plan, if you’re wanting to upgrade). Click Change.
9. Follow the steps to confirm the change.
